items.title: Researcher Discloses Five High-Risk Vulnerabilities in Palo Alto GlobalProtect
items.description: A security researcher has disclosed five vulnerabilities that he responsibly reported to Palo Alto Networks, affecting GlobalProtect, the VPN and endpoint agent used across thousands of enterprise networks worldwide. The disclosure, published through a dedicated research site, has reignited debate over how vendors handle vulnerability reports even when researchers follow coordinated disclosure…

items.title: Weedhack Malware Spreads via Fake Minecraft Clients and SEO Poisoning
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have found that several websites are still actively distributing a malware family known as Weedhack to gamers by masquerading as Minecraft clients. McAfee Labs said it detected and blocked more than 6,300 attempts to access malicious sites, adding that it found lookalike gaming websites designed to mimic legitimate projects, including branding, feature lists, FAQs,
